prompts.action-default:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production bitmap UI control for a modern Korean urban organization strategy game, FIRST MASTER MATERIAL reference.
Create exactly ONE premium DEFAULT secondary action button surface, with a genuinely transparent background. It is an empty image surface for live HTML text placed over its center, absolutely no lettering, no numbers, no icons, no logos, no watermark. Front-on orthographic flat view, absolutely no perspective.
A wide slim 3:1 command plate, graphite metal and very deep desaturated petrol-teal ceramic enamel, subtle fine industrial grain, refined restrained architectural edge machining. A clean mostly-flat center taking 80% of its area, generous uncluttered text space. Asymmetric short clipped upper-left/lower-right corners; a thin warm-ivory hairline glint only on a short top-left segment, a tiny dim amber inset pilot slit near the left edge, a few barely perceptible non-letter technical etch marks near the far right edge. Frame must be very thin, flush, precise, no ornamental box frame, no raised chunky bevel. Expensive contemporary neo-noir operations room physical interface, elegant and disciplined, not generic sci-fi HUD.
Palette charcoal #111a1e, deep teal #182b31, graphite #26363b, tiny muted amber #b68b46 accent and ivory #ded9c8. No bright neon.
The control should occupy almost the full width, with only 2% transparent outer safety margin. Overall silhouette must be wide, low, straight, softly chamfered not rounded. Deliver crisp detailed raster texture, pristine alpha edge. Prefer 1536 by 512 pixels canvas.
Avoid: old fantasy gold frame, jewelry box, raised corner decorations, brass corner caps, rivets, gem stones, ornate filigree, gold border around entire button, gradients resembling default CSS rounded rectangles, glossy plastic, heavy scratches, dirt, vignette or background rectangle, separate floating objects, display scene mockup. The output is only the ONE isolated reusable empty button.
